native.runtime: Existing verified 2.2.0 bundled native portal and Node 22.23.4; current source semantic backend.

verifiedBehaviors: Effective entity patches and explicit property removals preserve unknown attributes and typed values.
Exact array index and beforeHash distinguish parallel component links; endpoint integrity uses final atomic state.
DocHub direct-child creation is explicit and context membership changes use separate visible entity patches.
Declared source/target entity schemas support integration and flow CRUD; arbitrary entities retain advanced JSON editing.
Pending creation and deletion are reflected in schema reference choices and dictionaries; existing three-argument editor API remains compatible.
Model files, generated diagram YAML and Markdown and overlapping imports form one draft with unchanged source until normal validation and apply.
Deletion references are section-aware: known DocHub links, static context membership, composition, composer bindings and declared schema references; prose coincidences do not block.
Saved diagram ownership is checked against the original model, allowing reviewed combined deletion and diagram updates.
Read-only targets, stale intent, malformed or oversized operations and unresolved deletion references cannot stage.
Git and directory native validation, save, reload and reopen succeed; layout-only saves leave semantic objects unchanged.
limitations: No automatic subtree rename, reparenting, wildcard expansion or inference of undeclared custom reference semantics.
Unsupported or dynamic custom schemas and references remain the responsibility of the required native model validation.
Network traffic is not instrumented by the native-only harness; separate browser acceptance is required.
Final 2.3.0 bundle rebuild, relocated acceptance and deployment are pending in the parent task.
privacy: Statuses, counters, check names, relative source references and file digests only; no local absolute paths, tokens or source model captures.
